title: The manager's log page: copy button per entry, and a click opens the entry formatted in a popup
notes:
The manager's Log section (src/renderer/manager/log-view.ts) lists entries as now. Add:
- A copy button at the end of each entry's row, copying the whole entry as JSON (keyboard first: a key copies the selected row, conventions-rule-1; help row and blurb, keys-rule-2).
- A click on an entry, or Enter on the selected row, opens it in a popup like the drawer's viewer for markdown files (src/renderer/drawer/doc-viewer.ts / data-viewer.ts, which already formats JSON with folds): the entry pretty-printed as JSON, with any stack shown as readable lines, not one escaped string. Escape closes it; copy works there too.
- Old entries in the user's dashboard.log must work: an entry with only time, level, kind, project, message opens and copies fine, and a line the parser skips never breaks the page. Test against a fixture of the user's real older lines (copy a few from ~/.config/Dashboard or wherever the log lives, scrubbed of anything private).

Reuse the drawer's viewer rather than a second JSON formatter. Decisions (what the popup shows for an entry, how a stack is split into lines) in small modules with tests (workflow-rule-2). Docs: manager README (Log section), history. Pairs with the card for richer log entries (stack, cause, source), but works without it.

comments.body: Cancelled 2026-11-09: Reza is reviewing this work instead.
Back in Doing 2026-11-09: the cancel was meant for another pane.

Shipped in #250: Enter or a click opens a log entry in the drawer's JSON viewer (error stack and causes one frame to a line, plus #248's source, action, channel, context and build). Alt+C or the row button copies it as JSON, and Alt+C works in the popup too. Older five-field entries work the same. Tested against a scrubbed fixture of real old and new log lines.
